1.explanation: This snippet sets up an HTTP server that deliberately causes two sequential redirects before finally serving an HTML page. Lighthouse is then run against the initial URL (/start), which triggers the “Avoid multiple page redirects” audit as an opportunity. By saving the HTML output and viewing it in a browser, you’ll see that the final opportunity row is rendered in a compressed layout exactly as in the bug report screenshot. This reproduces the squished redirect opportunity issue in the performance report.
1.bug_scenario: When you generate a Lighthouse performance report for a page that has multiple redirects, the “Avoid multiple page redirects” opportunity row (usually at the bottom of the “Opportunities” section) collapses into a squished layout. Instead of rendering its sparkline bar and aligned savings text like the other rows, the savings text is wrapped into two lines (“Potential savings” on one line, “1,550 ms” on the next) and the row height shrinks, making the row look compressed compared to the others.
